The '''Desert of the Real''' was a region of the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that was located west of [[Outpost Thorazan]]. At the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the area was roamed by Rills and Womp rats.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==History==
In [[3643 BBY]], an ancient sandworm was killed in the area.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the area there is a [[sand caterpillar]], from which the player can fly with the [[Jawa balloon]] to the hiding place of a [[datacron]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
